name: João Miguel Silva
title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Highly accomplished Principal Machine Learning Engineer with over a decade of experience in designing, developing, and deploying robust AI/ML solutions. Proven expertise in leading cross-functional teams, optimizing model performance, and driving innovation in data-intensive environments. Specializes in scalable machine learning architectures and MLOps practices.

Designed and optimized deep learning models for customer churn prediction, achieving a 92% accuracy rate and influencing retention strategies for over 5 million users.
Mentored junior engineers and established best practices for Python-based ML development, code reviews, and testing frameworks.
Developed and productionized a recommendation engine that increased user engagement by 20% and conversion rates by 8% using collaborative filtering and deep learning.
Optimized existing machine learning models, leading to a 25% reduction in inference latency and a 15% decrease in operational costs on AWS.
Implemented A/B testing frameworks for ML features, providing data-driven insights that guided product development and feature prioritization.
Contributed to the design of a robust data pipeline for streaming analytics, processing over 1TB of data daily using Apache Spark.
Built and deployed predictive models for inventory optimization, resulting in a 10% reduction in stockouts and a 5% improvement in supply chain efficiency.
Developed custom Python libraries for data preprocessing and feature engineering, enhancing model development speed by 20%.
Collaborated with data scientists to implement novel algorithms for market trend analysis, providing key insights for strategic business decisions.
